impact.text: This will permanently block the other operator from registering any agent instance for any service in the future, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) attack.

precondition_sources.text: An attacker can create a service with many slots for the purpose of the attack.
The service can be created without the intention to push it to deploy, kept at ActiveRegistration state to register instances.
The victim's address is an operator address used to register agent instances.

intent_sources.text: An operator address must not be usable as an agent instance address while it is in use as an operator address; it may only be used as an instance address after its registered instance count reaches zero.

impact.text: The feature where an operator can register instances for many services with the same address is broken.

intent_sources.text: An operator must be able to register instances for many services with the same address.
